items.title: A new look
items.body: Dark, photo-first design across Home, Explore and caller profiles. Full-bleed portraits, live status, verified badges and a floating navigation bar.

items.title: Swipe to meet callers
items.body: Home is now a deck of caller cards. Swipe left to skip, swipe right or tap the heart to start a call. Switch between For You and Live.

items.title: Explore grid
items.body: Browse everyone in a two-column photo wall with quick filters for Live now, Language and Topics.

items.title: Richer profiles
items.body: Hero photo, per-minute rates, stats, About Me, topics and languages, reviews and a one-tap Chat / Talk now bar.

items.title: Smoother everywhere
items.body: Shimmer loading, staggered entrance animations, press feedback and shared-element transitions from Explore into profiles.
